hypothesis: For each of four frozen models (SmolLM2, Sprocket chat, Sprocket instruct, void.1), a per-token 8x8x4 spatially local field persistent across transformer depth can improve held-out quality relative to matched noncellular residual adapter under identical within-model budgets. No cross-model/tokenizer causal comparison is implied.

smollm2.numeric_oracle: same pinned HF checkpoint in torch.float32

sprocket_chat.checkpoint_state: pinned chat/model.safetensors presence and architecture confirmed by metadata-only Actions 40401534069; full weight byte hash, tokenizer/template semantics, model forward parity remain pending
sprocket_chat.numeric_oracle: same pinned HF chat checkpoint if independently verified; root instruct and chat GGUF are not equivalent substitutes

sprocket_instruct.tokenizer_protocol: root tokenizer + instruct tool/memory control tokens; chat template and explicit serialization must be checked before training
sprocket_instruct.checkpoint_state: published root instruct HF safetensors; exact pinned source/byte SHA, special-token template and forward parity PENDING new NCR-001A preflight
sprocket_instruct.numeric_oracle: same pinned HF root instruct checkpoint; not chat or GGUF

void1.tokenizer_protocol: ByteTokenizer from exact pinned source, remote Python source must be independently reviewed and hashed before trust_remote_code; raw bytes/characters/units tracked separately
void1.checkpoint_state: TRAIN-002b #1 CPU LoRA proven at exact pin; NCR-001A weight/file metadata inventory PENDING; full bytes and model-forward parity reserved for #79/#72
void1.numeric_oracle: same pinned Qwen3 HF checkpoint with reviewed custom byte tokenizer

architecture.state_semantics: one explicit [B,T,4,8,8] field per forward; independent across tokens; lives across depth taps only; reinitialized on new forward, request or generation step
architecture.tap_selection: zero-based post-block indices floor(N/3)-1, floor(2N/3)-1, N-1; model-specific pinned [9,19,29] SmolLM2; [7,16,25] both Sprocket variants; [7,15,23] void.1 Qwen3. Do not assume a Llama block interface for void.1.
architecture.neighborhood: 3x3 spatial same-weight local update, zero-padding, no wraparound and no token-axis interaction
architecture.update: bounded gated residual update with shared weights over cells and all depth taps; hidden-token projection supplies observations at each tap
architecture.readout: additive residual projection from flattened field to hidden state, output projection initialized identically to zero
architecture.backbone_policy: four independent frozen HF base checkpoints and model-specific projections, shared algorithm only; base model variants never substituted; no GGUF gradient path

match_constraints.sprocket_variant_pairing: chat vs instruct is a descriptive across-checkpoint comparison only; each NCA effect computed relative to own checkpoint and control
match_constraints.byte_tokenizer: void.1 byte-level tokenizer units are not comparable to other models' BPE tokens; report UTF-8 bytes/s, chars/s, EOS/truncation and byte-normalized CE separately

train_003.heldout_data_role: SEALED: evaluation only; never adapt/train/prompt-select on it
train_003.model_applicability: within-model mechanic evaluation; not evidence of Sprocket-vs-SmolLM2 parity

training.hardware: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04, four exposed vCPUs, CPU-only initial qualification
training.optimizer: AdamW; details fixed in NCR-001F before any training
training.preflight_gate: no training while protocol.train_authorized=false or per-model NCR-001E fails
training.void1_tokenizer_unit_policy: initial 256 training units per sample is provisional and may truncate even basic responses; must preflight actual byte length and preregister revised cap before training

evaluation.primary_effect: matched NCA minus within-model MLP on fixed sealed task metric
evaluation.improvement_gate: Per-model bounded GO only if NCA outperforms parameter-matched gate on own predeclared held-out metric without material CE/coherence regressions and within compute overhead; initial target >=0.03 absolute mechanical-score delta, >=2 of 3 seeds nonnegative, <=0.01 nats/byte (void.1) or nats/token (BPE models) natural-text CE regression, <=1.5x decode wall overhead on matched CPU. These are candidate—not yet accepted—gates and not cross-tokenizer comparisons.
evaluation.stop_rules: Unverified exact checkpoint, source variant substitution, unreviewed remote tokenizer code, causal/cache failure, NaN or resource breach blocks that individual model; other qualified lanes may proceed. Missing fixture/source hash or optimizer lock forbids comparative training. No silent chat/instruct swap.

provenance.staging_only: GitHub Actions artifacts are not the durable archive
